verdict.rationale: Proton Pass documents secure vault sharing, vaults for organizing items such as work logins, and built-in TOTP generation for saved logins. Together these suggest a team can share TOTP-bearing logins through a shared vault. Nothing in the evidence describes per-member access control, roles or permissions, or any admin/team management, and the sharing claim is a bare feature-list line. Missing for 10: per-member access control or permission levels on shared vaults, admin/team management features, detailed sharing docs confirming TOTP fields are shared, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, my team can share TOTP-protected logins through shared vaults or collections with per-member access control

citations.quote: Proton Pass can securely generate TOTP codes for websites that you have saved login details for.
Vaults can be used to organize items — in the example above, we have a vault for personal items and one for work items.
